The SIM Card needs to be checked here.when the Technician arrives. Please use the Teltonika Quickstart Guide.

additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
We already have a ticket (#ID0390191) in the RC-FR queue for the same charger and the site visit scheduled for December 13, 2024. The customer reported the ticket due to an OCPP connection lost, and we have provided the following troubleshooting steps:
The SIM Card needs to be checked here.when the Technician arrives. Please use the Teltonika Quickstart Guide.
QSG RUT240 - Teltonika Networks Wiki
Also Check if the SIM Card is ready and operating also trying a already working SIM is an option.  If the SIM card worked before and now its not that could be caused by a long term OFF status of the charger.
When you visit the site, please carry a router and a SIM card as well.
